Calculate standard sample entropy for the supplied single-channel series, m=2, threshold r=0.45 in the same units, Chebyshev strict distance < r. For both lengths use the same starting positions that permit length m+1; count unique unordered pairs and exclude self-matches. Report counts_m, counts_m_plus_1, and sample_entropy using natural logs.

For order 3, delay 1, calculate the normalized permutation entropy of this single channel. Report pattern_counts as counts in lexicographic order of the six permutations of [0,1,2], and normalized_perm_entropy with normalization log(3!).

Calculate approximate entropy at m=2 using Chebyshev strict distance < 0.65 and self-matches. For each embedding length use all fitting windows and take the mean log neighbor fraction. Report phi_m, phi_m_plus_1, and approximate_entropy.
